"""Policy language: lexing, parsing and the declared static bounds.

The public language is zero or more ``PREDICATE ACTION ;`` rules whose
predicates concern sequences of registered *services*, not characters.
This module only recognises syntax and enforces the declared limits; it never
evaluates predicates and never builds automata (see ``compiler.compiler``).

Recognised predicates::

    match(PATH)  startswith(PATH)  endswith(PATH)  contains(PATH)
    (P and P)    (P or P)          not(P)

Only space, tab, form feed, CR and LF are ignored *between* tokens; vertical
tab and every other Unicode whitespace character is forbidden anywhere in a
policy string.  Characters inside a service name are never ignored.
"""
import re

__all__ = ['PolicyError', 'parse', 'RULE_LIMITS']


class PolicyError(Exception):
    """Lexical, syntactic or declared-bound violation of the policy language."""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- lexing ----
_ALLOWED_CHARS = frozenset(
    ' \t\n\r\fABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789(),;')
_TOKEN = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z0-9]+|[(),;]')
_NAME = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}').fullmatch
_ATOMS = frozenset(('match', 'startswith', 'endswith', 'contains'))

# Declared per-string bounds (see PROTOCOL.md "Policy language and images").
MAX_DEPTH = 16             # predicate nesting depth; an atom has depth 1
MAX_PATH = 16              # services in one path
MAX_COMPLEX_RULES = 8      # rules whose predicate is not a single match atom
MAX_COMPLEX_ATOMS = 32     # atom occurrences inside one complex predicate
MAX_DISTINCT_NONMATCH = 4  # distinct non-match atoms per string
MAX_NONMATCH_PATH = 4      # services in a non-match atom path
MAX_ATOMS = 32768          # atom occurrences per string
MAX_PATHS = 65536          # path-service occurrences per string
MAX_RULES = MAX_ATOMS      # every rule contains at least one atom
_TOKEN_CAP = 500000        # a valid string never needs more tokens than this

RULE_LIMITS = {
    'max_depth': MAX_DEPTH, 'max_path': MAX_PATH,
    'max_complex_rules': MAX_COMPLEX_RULES, 'max_complex_atoms': MAX_COMPLEX_ATOMS,
    'max_distinct_nonmatch': MAX_DISTINCT_NONMATCH, 'max_nonmatch_path': MAX_NONMATCH_PATH,
    'max_atoms': MAX_ATOMS, 'max_paths': MAX_PATHS,
}

def _predicate(stream, allowance):
    """Parse one predicate.

    ``allowance`` is the maximum nesting depth this subtree may use; an atom
    consumes one level and each wrapper one level on top of its child.
    Returns ``(node, atoms, path_services, nonmatch_atoms)``.
    """
    if allowance < 1:
        raise PolicyError('nesting depth')
    tok = stream.tok

            raise PolicyError('nesting depth')

        op = stream.take()
        if op != 'and' and op != 'or':
            raise PolicyError('binary operator')
        right, ra, rp, rn = _predicate(stream, allowance - 1)

            raise PolicyError('closing parenthesis')
        return (op, left, right), la + ra, lp + rp, ln + rn

            raise PolicyError('opening parenthesis')

            raise PolicyError('closing parenthesis')
